items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: there was trumpet player named Joe Sutler that nobody mentions... He was more famous then Louis Armstrong.

ctx.x: Already played all night so you‟ll hang out.
All the musicians and all the entertainers from all the other clubs are coming over there to play and hang out and these go on „til noon Sunday. TAYLOR; I‟ll be darned.
Then we had the Bookstore, a place called the Bookstore, after hour place. And I must mention to you, there was trumpet player named Joe Sutler that nobody mentions.
